policy.method: one constant prepared +Y BoneRoot translation from target idle at source zero
policy.region: body vertices with total same-side Foot/Toe skin weight greater than 0.5
policy.scope: idle, walk and three attacks share one target guard shift; no per-frame grounding or IK
policy.residual_policy: measure keys and midpoints without modifying authored relative foot heights

guard.role: canonical reference pose only; not a new runtime guard clip or mode

idle.curve: one small periodic1.5s inhale/exhale, exact closed guard endpoints; scalar cosine is smooth, exported glTF LINEAR is not globally C2

guard_authoring.left_wrist: actual rest forearm->hand local relation, no old dangling world Q
guard_authoring.right_wrist_and_weapon: original v5guard world hand position/quaternion held through shoulder release and every breath sample
guard_authoring.foot_policy: all original root/hip/leg/foot local TRS payloads fixed, no root travel or foot IK drift

preview_policy: Private base same-rest direct prepare only, target right-finger offsets once and existing target canonical root shift once; never use preview as RAW. Actual weapon binding including source Grip shift is handled by existing prepare_character.

production_boundary.actual_runtime_chain: ArenaSession.effectiveEnemyPose -> ArenaOpponents.selectEnemyPose(IDLE/guardedHIT) -> LocomotionProfile.sourceSeconds(moving=false) returns idle.samples.first().sourceSeconds; EnemyAnimator alive pauses and setTime(state.enemyPoseSourceSeconds). production_boundary.contact_anchor_requirement: Current LocomotionProfile expects idle contact/blade anchors constant. This candidate holds actual right hand/knife fixed; body/head motion still requires Root to migrate locked-body assumptions and drive one shared source clock.

limits: Source candidate and private base preview only; no published canonical family, runtime clock change, native playback or three-target acceptance.
Small breath amplitude does not imply continuous collision proof; bounded real surface tests and actual same-camera review remain required.
